metas.name: Sumatra - Aceh
metas.note: The satellite dishes in Aceh, tilted at an angle of approximately 74 to 78 degrees, are aligned towards the satellite in a south-east direction.
metas.footer:
How do I proceed in the game? The stationary satellite Telkom 4 is positioned at 108° East above the equator, just off the west coast of Kalimantan. You can aim for Pontianak, as the city is located on the equator along the coast, close to the satellite.

The simplest method is likely to orient yourself in-game to match the direction of the satellite dish. The dish's concave (inward-curving) side is generally aimed at the satellite.
